_comment: The example local-names file. Copy to <helm home>/_global/local-names.json
and edit: this file is documentation and is never read at runtime. It holds
the names of this operator's own projects, hosts and predecessor tools,
which helm's source does not carry. Every key is optional; without it the
behaviour it names is off or takes its neutral default, so a fresh clone
needs no file at all. Keys starting with '_' are ignored, and `helm doctor`
names an unreadable file, an unknown key and a value of the wrong shape.
predecessor         the tool helm replaced on this host (a lowercase word):
its <NAME>_* variables and its ~/.cache/<name>/,
~/.config/<name>/ and ~/.<name>-home-archive/ are still
honoured, and a keepalive it runs counts as a writer
qwen27-provider     the provider name the qwen27 pool row goes by (default
local-llamacpp); a seat minted under a name keeps it
local-operator-seat the seat that runs the local model families' hardware;
only it, from its own roster-bound session, certifies
them with `helm burn certify-local` (unset: nobody can),
and the local-serving steward #seats rows @mention
cred-steward-seat   the seat that owns credentials: every credential wall,
unblock, reset and default-home switch row in #seats
@mentions it (unset: the row wakes nobody and says so)
friction-steward-seat the seat that owns helm's guard friction: each row
the friction autopilot files, raises or refiles is
posted to #seats @mentioning it (unset: nobody is
woken and the row says where to declare it)
tick-steward-seat   the seat that owns helm's timer ticks: a tick leg that
fails 3 passes in a row posts one #seats row
@mentioning it (unset: nobody is woken and the row
says where to declare it); `helm doctor` FAILs the leg
dark-seat-mover     "off" makes the idle-dispatch tick's dark-seat mover
report only (unset: it moves a confirmed-dark seat's
work; `helm doctor` shows which)
builder-seats       the seats of the builder role, and reviewer-seats the
reviewer-seats      reviewer role's: a dark one's build rows and tasks move
to a live seat of its role, else to its steward
deploy-dir          the directory a deployed gate's scripts run from
deploy-project      the registered project whose checkout owns them
local-review-script the findings pass's reading script
fab-node            the build node an operator's A/B eval rig runs on by default
generic-keywords    words the knowledge store never treats as a topic

lead-denied-mcp-servers
                        MCP servers a lead seat never calls: its lean
                        profile denies them; unset, none is denied
public-names        names the private-name advisory treats as public,
beside its shipped allowlist (docs/CLASSIFY.md)
cubicle-floor       the Orca workspace whose first three panes are the
cubicles: the seat resume tick moves each fleet seat's
tab to pane 1 (walled), 2 (working) or 3 (local);
unset, no tab moves (`helm seat cubicles` shows it)
cubicle-mover       "off" stops those moves and "dry-run" plans them
only; unset, the tick moves
